subject.title: fix(acp): drop current-turn image attachments already described by media understanding

question: Should ACP dispatch intentionally stop forwarding raw current-turn image attachments once media understanding has produced an image.description for the same attachment index?
rationale: The source fix matches the non-ACP path, but it deliberately changes ACP runtime inputs and therefore needs maintainer acceptance of the compatibility and message-delivery boundary.

options.title: Require real ACP proof, then land
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal or live ACP output showing a text-only backend accepts the described image turn while undescribed, inline, and extracted images still reach the runtime.

options.title: Accept source proof only
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the source-level proof and tests as enough despite the external-PR real-behavior proof gate.

options.title: Pause for raw-image policy
options.body: If ACP vision-capable runtimes should keep raw images even after descriptions, pause this PR and sponsor a different policy shape.

recommendation.title: Require real ACP proof, then land
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal or live ACP output showing a text-only backend accepts the described image turn while undescribed, inline, and extracted images still reach the runtime.

likelyOwner.reason: The compatibility question centers on ACP attachment forwarding behavior originally introduced in the ACP attachment path.
